page.overview:
Who is Breha?

Breha was a Human female from the planet of Aquilae. She was the wife of King Kayos and bore the title of Queen Mother. She bore three children: Leia, Biggs and Windy.

Her name was eventually used for the name of Leia's adoptive mother Queen Breha Organa in Revenge Of The Sith.
